page.overview:
Who is Buzzy?

Buzzy, better known as Nightmare Bear is a recurring scenario character in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles & Other Strangeness by Palladium Books. Nightmare Bear is a member of the Terror Bears, a team of four teenage mutant bears.

Nightmare Bear has a take-charge type of personality, and his expectations are that everyone will obey his orders. He tends to be pushy and ill-tempered, especially when he's not listened to.

As the leader of the Terror Bears, Nightmare Bear is the one who creates the plans for the groups' future survival. He is the only one of the four who actually looks ahead to the future. He shares a hatred of humanity with the other Terror Bears and does his best to protect them. Nightmare Bear's Mind Traps have a unique quality because he brings the actual nightmare of his victims to life. Anyone he's caught will relive recent traumatic events and Nightmare Bear's manipulations will make their opponents and problems seem much greater than they are in reality.
